cases.query_text: how does the graph indexer resolve an external call target
cases.rationale: The ordinary shape: an unfiltered code query at the production candidate depth. Establishes whether the vector index agrees with a flat scan when nothing narrows the search.

cases.query_text: how does the graph indexer resolve an external call target
cases.rationale: The same query at a deeper candidate depth. Approximate search degrades differently with depth, so a candidate that helps at ten and hurts at fifty must be visible as two slices rather than averaged into one.
A prefiltered query. Prefiltering changes which rows the index may consider, so exact agreement under a filter is a separate contract from the unfiltered case.

cases.query_text: what does the review policy receipt bind
cases.rationale: The docs layer has a materially different corpus size and chunk-length distribution from code, so its agreement with exact search must be measured separately rather than assumed from the code layer.

cases.query_text: what does the review policy receipt bind
cases.rationale: The docs layer at depth, pairing the code layer's deep slice so both layers contribute the same slice shapes to the macro mean.
